description: Creates a public HTTPS URL that records every request sent to it (any method, any sub-path, headers, query and body), so you can receive webhooks and callbacks without a server of your own. Use it when something needs a URL to call back – a payment provider, a CI job, an OAuth or API integration, your own code under test – then give that URL to the sender and read what arrived with list_webhook_requests. Returns the capture URL, the bin id and a secret key (pass both to the other webhook tools), a private page link for a person to watch requests live in a browser, and the expiry (7 days). The URL answers every request with HTTP 200 {"ok":true} unless you set response_status/response_type/response_body.

name.description: Optional label for the bin, e.g. what it is for (at most 80 characters).

response_status.description: HTTP status the URL answers with. Default 200.

response_type.description: Content-Type of the answer. Default application/json.

name: create_webhook_url
title: Create a webhook URL
